verdict.rationale: Mailchimp exposes broad API surfaces for campaigns, audiences, transactional messaging, webhooks, and account exports, showing substantial API/UI overlap. However there is no explicit claim of full UI-API parity, and community reports describe UI-specific tools (drag-and-drop email builder, code module editing) that are not clearly API-accessible or scriptable, plus newer AI/analytics features are described only as UI/pricing-tier items with no API documentation. missing for 10: explicit parity statement, API coverage for generative AI/analytics AI features, API equivalents for drag-and-drop/code-module editing workflows.
